    memory:

    local:
      host: localhost
      port: 8000
    mrsm:

      username: default

docker-compose.yaml:
  services:
    db:
      environment:
        TIMESCALEDB_TELEMETRY: 'off'
        POSTGRES_USER: <DOLLAR>POSTGRES_USER
        POSTGRES_DB: <DOLLAR>POSTGRES_DB
        POSTGRES_PASSWORD: <DOLLAR>POSTGRES_PASSWORD
        ALLOW_IP_RANGE: 0.0.0.0/0
      command: postgres -c max_connections=1000 -c shared_buffers=1024MB -c max_prepared_transactions=100
      healthcheck:
        test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -d <DOLLAR>POSTGRES_DB -U <DOLLAR>POSTGRES_USER
        interval: 5s
        timeout: 3s
        retries: 5
      restart: always
      image: timescale/timescaledb-ha:pg18
      ports:
      - MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:sql:main:port}:5432
      hostname: db
      volumes:
      - meerschaum_db_data:/home/postgres/pgdata
      - {ROOT}/db/initdb:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d:z,ro
      shm_size: 1024m
      networks:
      - backend
    api:
      image: bmeares/meerschaum:api
      ports:
      - MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:api:main:port}:MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:api:main:port}
      hostname: api
      networks:
      - frontend
      - backend
      command: start api --production --port MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:api:main:port}
      healthcheck:
        test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - --fail
        - http://localhost:MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:api:main:port}/healthcheck
        interval: 5s
        timeout: 3s
        retries: 3
      environment:
        MRSM_CONFIG: |-
          {
              "meerschaum": MRSM{!meerschaum},
              "system": MRSM{!system},
              "api": MRSM{!api}
          }
        MRSM_PATCH: |-
          {
              "meerschaum": {
                  "connectors": {
                      "sql": {
                          "main": {
                              "host": "MRSM{stack:docker-compose.yaml:services:db:hostname}",
                              "port": 5432
                          },
                          "local": {
                              "database": "/meerschaum/sqlite/mrsm_local.db"
                          }
                      },
                      "valkey": {
                          "main": {
                              "host": "MRSM{stack:docker-compose.yaml:services:valkey:hostname}",
                              "port": 6379
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
      restart: always
      init: true
      depends_on:
        db:
          condition: service_healthy
        valkey:
          condition: service_healthy
      volumes:
      - api_root:/meerschaum
    valkey:
      image: valkey/valkey-bundle:latest
      restart: always
      environment:
        VALKEY_PASSWORD: <DOLLAR>VALKEY_PASSWORD
        VALKEY_RDB_POLICY_DISABLED: 'no'
        VALKEY_RDB_POLICY: 900#1 600#5 300#10 120#50 60#1000 30#10000
      hostname: valkey
      ports:
      - MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:valkey:main:port}:6379
      volumes:
      - valkey_data:/data
      healthcheck:
        test:
        - CMD
        - valkey-cli
        - ping
        interval: 5s
        timeout: 3s
        retries: 5
      networks:
      - backend
    grafana:
      image: grafana/grafana:latest
      ports:
      - 3000:3000
      networks:
      - frontend
      - backend
      restart: always
      depends_on:
        db:
          condition: service_healthy
      volumes:
      - grafana_storage:/var/lib/grafana
      - {ROOT}/stack/grafana/resources/provisioning/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources:z,ro
      - {ROOT}/stack/grafana/resources/provisioning/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards:z,ro
      environment:
        GF_SECURITY_ALLOW_EMBEDDING: 'true'
        GF_ANALYTICS_REPORTING_ENABLED: 'false'
        GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ENABLED: 'true'
        GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_NAME: Main Org.
        GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_ORG_ROLE: Viewer
        GF_AUTH_ANONYMOUS_HIDE_VERSION: 'true'
  networks:
    frontend: null
    backend: null
  volumes:
    api_root: null
    meerschaum_db_data: null
    grafana_storage: null
    valkey_data: null

grafana:
  dashboard:
    apiVersion: 1
    providers:
    - name: Default
      folder: Meerschaum Dashboards
      options:
        path: /etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
  datasource:
    apiVersion: 1
    datasources:
    - name: Meerschaum Main
      type: postgres
      jsonData:
        sslmode: disable
        postgresVersion: 1500
        timescaledb: true
        database: MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:sql:main:database}
      user: MRSM{meerschaum:connectors:sql:main:username}
      secureJsonData:

      url: MRSM{stack:docker-compose.yaml:services:db:hostname}:5432
      isDefault: true
      editable: true

{

    "all": {
      "pandas": "pandas"
    },
    "sql": {
      "bulk_insert": {
        "postgresql": true,

    "api": {}

    "refresh_seconds": 0.1,

      "start daemon",
      "start job",
      "stop job",
      "delete job",
      "stop daemon",
      "show daemon",
      "restart daemon",
      "install",
      "upgrade",
      "reload",
      "start worker",
      "show log",
      "python",
      "login",
      "executor",
      "os ",
      "sh ",

      "start webterm",
      "stack",
      "instance",
      "debug",
      "bootstrap",
      "daemon",
      "sql",
      "register plugin",
      "copy "
